chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: England in 1930: the Palladium with Gracie Fields
summary: After Blackbirds Buck and Bubbles went to England, splitting top billing with Gracie Fields and playing the Cafe de Paris.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: 1930 we go to England, right after "Blackbirds." 1930 we go to England, just Buck and I.
Did Nazarro set this up? For you to go to England?

He set it up but he messed it up after that, so we had to go on our own. So we went to England to the Palladium, splitting headlines with Gracie Fields, Gracie Fields was an English comedienne. And all the variety shows there. We played the Cafe de Paris. We played all the variety theaters there.
